name: Rocket Eruption: Triple Blast

features.name: Three rocket bonuses
features.description: One to three bonus games can trigger in one spin.

features.name: Combined rounds
features.description: Different rockets together create a combined bonus.

features.name: Sticky mystery symbols
features.description: Mystery symbols stick during bonus spins.

review:
Dinosaurs, volcanoes and rockets with a three-pots system. One to three bonuses can trigger in a single spin, and two or three different rockets landing together combine into one bigger bonus.

Mystery symbols turn sticky during bonus spins. The bonus comes round about once every 105 spins, and combined bonuses keep things unpredictable. Medium-low volatility, 5,000x max and 96.57% RTP.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 105 spins on average)
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
